messages.content: Please check whether the black Sony WH-1000XM5 is in stock for me — product_id p_sony_xm5_blk, quantity 1, in the electronics category. Then look up both regular and trending alternatives in electronics and choose one substitute to buy if needed. After that, reserve and confirm 1 unit of the Sony WH-1000XM5 Silver, get alice’s contact details, and generate a discounted PayPal invoice for the invoice_items [{product_id: p_sony_xm5_blk, quantity: 1}] for 1 black Sony WH-1000XM5 sent to alice@company.com, using payment_gateway paypal and payment_method card. Also look up Hilton Tokyo, get the current UTC time and convert that timestamp for timezone UTC. Finally, create and email via channel email a high-priority document titled “Substitute purchase confirmation” with this content: “A substitute item was purchased, invoiced with discount, and a travel hotel lookup was included for the customer.” Please associate it with user_id user_123 and tags shopping, invoice, travel.
